title: North Woods Law
description:

During a busy winter weekend, Lt. Boudreau encounters kite skiers, an illegal fire sled and a vandalized bob-house; Officer Canfield searches for a deer with an arrow in its head; Officers Demler and Towne head out on a treacherous mountain rescue.

title: North Woods Law
description:

Wardens spring into action when Maine's wildlife wanders into human territory; Marquis and Fitzpatrick try to catch a dumpster-diving bear; Warden Lounder chases a wily woodchuck.

title: North Woods Law
description:

Officers Bronson and Towne get more than they bargained for with a speeding snowmobiler; the K-9 unit performs winter training; Officer MacFadzen patrols an ice drag racing event; Officer Cyrs heads into the woods to investigate a hit-and-run.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E02 — Frozen Over
Officer Hannett patrols for ice fishermen while Lt. Boudreau investigates a hunter who shot towards a road; Officer Holmes deals with a raccoon hiding in a warm chimney; Officer St. Pierre goes on his first dive recovery under the ice.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S13 E01 — Wild Winter
Officer Bronson questions a hunter who shot a deer without having the proper permit; while Officer Demler runs radar on a popular snowmobile trail, Sgt. Lucas investigates a suspicious deer kill site; Officer Cyrs responds to a snowmobile accident.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S06 E01 — Shy Kitties: Pint Sized
In a cozy home of Himalayans, a shy kitten named Hugo follows in his father's footsteps; a rags-to-riches rescue mix brings her brood of puppies to their new dream home and only girl, Honey, makes an unlikely friend.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S06 E03 — Super Pups: Pint Sized
Twin dachshund pups, Lulu and Betty, discover their different personalities with a little bit of guidance from their free spirit father; a show pup in training, Chinese Crested Dotty, forms an unlikely friendship with rescue pit bull Bryan.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S06 E02 — Rescue Kittens & Water Babies: Pint Sized
A cat-loving rescue dog named Sweet Potato welcomes a pair of rescue kittens into their new foster home.

title: Too Cute!
description:
S06 E04 — Graceful Giants: Pint Sized
Chip, a golden retriever puppy, tries to be the center of attention; a Great Dane's long legs make the dog a tad clumsy.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E05 — Hope for Hoppy
Dr. Ross performs surgery on a second-chance pup; Dr. Lavigne checks up on a prickly pet; Dr. Blue treats an injured owl, then joins Dr. Ross in checking on a cute litter of sick, tiny piglets.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E06 — Training Day
Dr. Lavigne attacks an older dog's tumors; Dr. Ross tries to save a rabbit's foot mauled by a dog; Dr. Blue takes on a mission to castrate a violent donkey.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E08 — Lights, Camera, Action!
A mother dog with two puppies stuck in her uterus needs an emergency C-section; Dr. Ross and Dr. Lavigne address eye issues; vets make a video for the clinic.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E04 — Raining Cats, Dogs, and Tigers
The clinic takes in displaced animals during the massive flooding in Houston; Dr. Blue helps a puppy with a deadly disease acquired from standing water; Dr. Lavigne and Dr. Ross examine a wandering tiger.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E06 — Graveyard of Peed on Things
A woman's cat Pip is a one-eyed feline with cerebellar hypoplasia who torments her other cat, Red; a little girl's birthday present named Autumn is destructive to their home and targets the couch, beds, computer monitor and microwave.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E05 — Macho Cat
A couple who has moved in together have merged the lives of their two cats. Since the move, Buddy has become territorial and a bully; two roommates adopted a cat who destroys and pees on everything in their apartment.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S04 E04 — Feral Scottish Fold
Buddy's owners are determined to transform him into the perfect indoor cat, despite his aggressive tendencies; Kali was recently adopted but due to her terrorizing behavior she may end up back in the shelter.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E10 — Trying to Deal with the Devil
Deep in Mexico's Baja desert lies the scorching wasteland of the Devil's Canyon; a Canadian mountain man teams up with an experienced homesteader to take on the canyon's triple-digit heat, scarce water, and venomous predators.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
21 Miles, 21 Days
In a lethal African hunting ground, a biker chick and a taxidermist have to stay on the move to survive; the pair must push across 21 miles of savanna to find food and water while avoiding a pride of lions that's tracking them every step of the way.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E09 — Blood, Sweat and Fears
Two survivalists are back for redemption in the Mexican jungle but torrential downpours, competing survival styles and a machete accident threaten to send them home early again.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E06 — Close Encounters
Two strangers are dropped in one of the most dangerous African locations in the dead heat of summer; faced with aggressive hippos and charging elephants, they quickly learn their place but must mark their territory if they want to make it 21 days.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S19 E08 — Clash of the Survivalists
Forced to trek two days to a water source, a laid-back hunter and an opinionated adventurer clash in Zambia, risking their 21-day challenge; as danger mounts, their trust cracks.

description:

Two survivalists fight to endure 21 days of extreme dehydration in the drought-stricken Everglades. With no potable water available, the pair is threatened with an early tap-out.

description:

While vacationing in South Africa, Peter Knottenbelt suddenly finds himself in the jaws of a massive crocodile; in Nova Scotia, Meg Doyle is walking her beloved dog when they're suddenly ambushed by a pair of angry raccoons.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E07 — All Alone
During an archery hunt in Cranbrook, British Columbia, Chad Dueck comes face-to-face with a mother grizzly bear; in Tracy, Calif., Walt Dean King is savagely attacked by a Brahma Bull roaming his neighborhood.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E06 — Safari Horror
Bob Legasa is hunting in Montana and what he thinks is a bluff charge from a grizzly bear is, in fact, a near-lethal attack; while canoeing in Zimbabwe, Kristen Yaldor is thrown into the water and finds herself in the jaws of a hippopotamus.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E01 — A Python Ate My Pet
The Venom One team encounters a python with a possible family pet in its stomach.

title: Swamp Wars
description:

Floridians face threats from carnivorous African Nile monitor lizards, red-tailed boa constrictors and poisonous Eastern diamondbacks.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E03 — Killer Bees Attack
The Venom One team stages a rescue when deadly bees threaten an elderly living facility.

title: Swamp Wars
description:

The Venom One team races to contain a 400-pound alligator, angry crocodiles and poisonous snakes.

Jeremy Wade returns to the Okavango Delta to re-investigate a predatory carnivore that may have mauled over 100 victims of a capsized boat; to discover the truth, Jeremy offers himself up as live bait.

description:

Jeremy Wade is lured to the shores of the Mekong River in Cambodia to search for a monstrous fish that has mauled, blinded, killed and most recently sliced clean through a young man's testicle.

description:

On the tropical island of Sulawesi, Indonesia, a tourist snorkeler and several local fishermen have been killed and injured by a mysterious sea creature that impales its victims; Wade travels to the scene to investigate.

description:

description:

description:

description:

The team is determined to have Gibson the sea otter pup discover his independence as he separates from his pal, Mara; the African penguins head off-site for spring-cleaning; Thor the moray eel proves he's the ultimate escape artist.

Wayde and Brett attempt to create a unique, enormous, ship-shaped tank with a replica of the USCGC Mohawk for the Imaginarium Science Center.

ATM constructs an aquarium of the glowing Atlanta skyline for rap superstar 2 Chainz.

title: Tanked

ATM builds a Smile More aquarium for YouTube superstar Roman Atwood; but a shop prank almost tanks the whole project.

Paul and Jimmy get off to a rocky start in Mississippi; the boys work in sweltering heat to finish a gator pit before the wrestling shows can begin.

The boys rescue a creepy-looking alligator; Jimmy battles a canebrake rattlesnake; Ashley becomes the marketing director of the Gulf Coast Gator Ranch.

Navigating the complex issues of deer management, Dan Cabela travels between Scotland and England to learn how land managers balance conservation with wild food harvesting.

A look at what would cause a ferocious tiger shark to cuddle up with a diver and why pigs are swimming in the Caribbean; and what mysterious blobs have washed up by the thousands on the shores of Oregon.

description:

Two adorable tiger cubs need to move to the adult exhibit; a silverback gorilla receives pioneering treatment to curb his worsening eyesight; a passionate keeper plays matchmaker to a peculiar pair of birds.

title: The Zoo
description:
S01 E02 — Moving Day
The Zoo's huge male sea lion is in rut, and staff need to move the younger males before he becomes territorial; the veterinary team come up with a solution to repair Dinky the Flamingo's broken ankle; feeding a rock python proves challenging.

title: The Zoo
description:
S01 E03 — Handle With Care
A tomistoma, a freshwater crocodilian, stops laying eggs and a team of keepers scrambles to treat her; the veterinary team has to rescue a baby antelope that isn't getting the care it needs from its mother; Mert the Goose takes a field trip.
